title: Weekend Island Break with Colombo and Bentota
highlights: Spend the ultimate holiday in Sri Lanka, famous for lush rainforests, scenic hills, and beautiful beaches.
Visit Galle fort and look at the beauty of iconic attractions like Maritime Museum and Meera Mosque.
Relax at the beautiful Mirissa beach while admiring the unique Parrot Rock formation and se views from the Coconut Tree Hill.
Experience Colombo's rich culture while exploring popular attractions like Gangaramaya Temple and Pettah Floating Market.
overview:
About the Tour:
Sri Lanka is bottled up with beautiful nature trails, stunning vistas and waterfalls, misty mountains rising into the clouds, golden beaches which is why it is known as the "Teardrop of India", it gives a variety of holiday experiences from pristine sandy sea shores of Mirissa where you can surf and observe the waters teeming with marine life, from turtles to big blue whales, bask in the sunny beach with a quiet and secluded environment adrenaline pumping adventure sports at Bentota such as snorkelling, windsurfing, etc., pass through several small islands in this lovely Madu River covered with the mangroves and even witness the making of the favorite cinnamon spice and discover the vibrancy of Colombo and explore a variety of fascinating attractions, as well as interacting with its authentic people. Delve into the city’s cultural diversity as you traverse through the colorful streets of the lively market.


Quick Info:
Route: Colombo - Bentota - Colombo
Duration: 4 Days & 3 Nights
Start Point: Bandaranaike International Airport (Colombo)
End Point: Bandaranaike International Airport (Colombo)
inclusions: Transfer from Bandaranaike International Colombo Airport to Standard Hotel
2 nights stay in Bentota with breakfast
Full Day Bentota Sightseeing Tour on a Private basis - Ticket/Cost not included
Excursion to Mirissa on a Private basis - Ticket/Cost not included
1 night stay in Colombo with breakfast
Full Day Colombo Sightseeing Tour on a Private basis - Ticket/Cost not included
Transfer from Deluxe Hotel to Bandaranaike International Colombo Airport
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions

meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Colombo | Transfer to Bentota
days.desc: Upon arrival, get transferred from the airport to the hotel in Bentota for check-in. Then, board the transfer for the Bentota sightseeing tour. Visit Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery, and Madu River. Enjoy water sports like jet ski at Bentota beach. Later, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Full Day Bentota Sightseeing Tour on a Private basis

days.title: Excursion to Mirissa
days.desc: Get assisted for an excursion to Mirissa. Visit Galle fort, see attractions like Galle Lighthouse, Meera Mosque, etc., then, continue to Mirissa beach. Admire views from the Coconut Tree Hill, and the Parrot Rock. You can also go for whale watching (early morning show). Get transferred to the hotel.

items.title: Excursion to Mirissa on a Private basis

days.title: Arrival in Colombo | Colombo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Check-out and get transferred to the hotel in Colombo for check-in. Then, get assisted for a city sightseeing tour. Explore iconic attractions like Lotus Tower, Gangaramaya Buddhist Temple, Pettah Floating Market, and more. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
